question: whether the pause byte and the autosave request work when written from outside

struct_fields.name: paused
struct_fields.comment: Whether the game is paused (confirmed in the running game, 2026-11-10: the store alone stops and starts the clock): slot 95 (IsPaused) answers it, TogglePause (slot 27) sets it or calls Unpause (slot 71), which clears it outside a custom game; Enter sets it at 0x65C737 and 0x6606E8 - a game comes up paused. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-ingamemenu.md, section A.2.
struct_fields.evidence: Written 0 with +0x12D9 at 1, the clock ran; written 1 from a breakpoint on RunHourlyPass, it stopped on that hour.

struct_fields.name: autosave_requested
struct_fields.comment: an autosave is wanted. Set by hand in the running game on 2026-11-10 while paused, the save was written within seconds, under the name autosave.hoi3: the request is honoured whether or not the clock runs.
struct_fields.evidence: autosave.hoi3 written at date 1938.8.3.16, the game paused throughout.
